scope: PVIDEO implementation and native startup-video synchronization. Full GTA gameplay acceptance is a separate step.
trigger: Original GTA SA with XP 175.16 reached 1207 startup-video draws, then the original nv4_disp watchdog reported 0xEA while waiting for its video notification at record offset 0x20.
ownerConfiguration: i440FX, IDE, ACPI off, one core, 2048 MiB requested RAM, 256 MiB VRAM; driver installation already restarted; no proxy DLLs copied by the owner.

nativeProtocolEvidence.description: Undocumented counter semantics are inferred from this provided driver's real register traffic and disassembly, rather than claimed as exhaustive hardware documentation.

localDisassemblyVA.interruptHandler: 0x1B4CC6: acknowledge PVIDEO INTR bit 8, sample 8B08 counter/completion fields
localDisassemblyVA.offsetSubmission: 0x1B54A0: test 8B08 bit 24 before writing 8B10/8B14; 0x1B56DF: arm the 12-bit target through 8B0C bit 16
localDisassemblyVA.displayCounterSample: 0x1B5A7E and 0x1B5DE7: read 8B04 bits 16..27 when selecting an offset target

implementation: Latch validated packed-video descriptors at retrace; route legacy buffer interrupts in bits 0/4 and scheduled-offset completion in bit 8 through PMC bit 16.
Advance 12-bit display/scheduler retrace samples; honor future and late wrapping targets, expose the pending-slot busy bit, and preserve active/pending work in snapshot version 10.
Composite packed YUV with clipping and primary-plane color key before gamma. Reject unsupported planar or invalid VRAM extents without fabricated DMA completion.
Leave notification writes, watchdog behavior, guest clocks, game code and driver code to the unmodified guest.
validation: Packed YUV black/white pixel checks in both byte orders; clipping, keying and pre-gamma matching.
Doorbell-to-retrace ordering, independent interrupt bits, checked invalid transfers, counter/consumer wrap, late/future deadlines, busy-slot preservation and state migration.
Real PCI/MMIO PMC routing and W1C; byte-written target doorbell; actual VM snapshot round trip.
NV40 graph, FIFO, state, texture, 2D and checkpoint units; real Chrome WebGPU rendering regression.

Original 175.16 resumed its own notification processing and rendered GTA Main Menu, New Game menu and the airport opening scene. Scene loading separately exposed DirectX vertex-format 0x41/0x21 decode gaps, so this fixture does not claim complete GTA gameplay.
limits: Nearest overlay scaling; planar video, full undocumented PVIDEO behavior and cycle-accurate timing remain unvalidated. Restored-state causality runs are not substitutes for final cold-boot gameplay acceptance.
